newsitem.title: INDONESIA: PT Samarco to build palmoil refinery near Sumatra.
newsitem.headline: PT Samarco to build palmoil refinery near Sumatra.

text.p: Indonesia's PT Samarco Makmun Indah will build a palmoil refinery on Bangka Island off South Sumatra at a cost of 15 billion rupiah, the official Antara news agency reported on Tuesday.
Quoting a company official, the agency said Samarco had cultivated 6,500 hectares of its proposed 25,000-hectare plantation on the island with oil palm trees.
Indonesia, the world's second-biggest producer of palmoil after neighbouring Malaysia, is forecast to produce 4.9 million tonnes this year, up from 4.5 million tonnes in 1995.
